item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your calendar is full of reminders about routines and checking in with yourself, so use that structure. Medication works best when it's tied to something you already do every day, like your morning meditation. Right now, nothing is anchored to it. Skipped doses and guesswork add stress you don't need. Decide where it fits, and don't rely on memory. Your action: attach your medication to your morning meditation, starting today.
